notes: Read all 477 source lines line by line before editing. This is pure, non-visual aggregation/type code (period stats, prior period, anomaly detection, notable sessions, daily trend, charger category) — no DOM, JSX, Recharts, Leaflet, or browser-only behavior — so every type and computation is ported verbatim with identical behavior (contract rule 6). Only platform primitives used are Date, Intl.NumberFormat, Intl.DateTimeFormat/formatToParts, Math, Map, Set — all available on Hermes and in the Jest/Node gate env (formatToParts already has native-parity precedent in components/forms/CurrencyInput.tsx).

L15-27 imports + re-exports: web imports four `@/*` modules with no native parity port yet, so — matching the established native convention in features/charging/components/charging-list/helpers.ts — the lib deps are inlined as native-safe local ports. Inlined native-safe dep ports (preserving exact web logic): numberFormat.ts safeNumber + fmtNumber(v, decimals=2, locale='en-US') via Intl.NumberFormat — every L329/L352/L361/L370 call passes explicit precision and the web global locale default is 'en-US', so output is byte-identical. scoreScale.ts ScoreGrade union, ScoreGradeInfo interface, GRADE_PALETTE (A+ #10b981 4.5, A #10b981 4.0, B #00f0ff 3.0, C #f59e0b 2.0, D #ef4444 1.0, F #b91c1c 0.5, — #6b7280 null), DEFAULT_SCORE_THRESHOLDS (90/80/65/50/35/0) and numericToGrade (null/NaN -> —; highest-first match; loop var renamed t->th to avoid any reader confusion, no behavior change) — used by L238 batteryFriendlyGrade. dateFormat.ts ymdInTz (device-local YYYY-MM-DD when no tz; Intl.DateTimeFormat formatToParts for tz path with try/catch fallback to device-local) backs localDayKey. drivesAggregation private helpers ymdToUtcMillis/utcMillisToYmd back priorPeriod.
